
# LanCache-NG (https://github.com/wiki-mod/lancache-ng)

# What: valid and invalid cdn-domains entries.
# Why: cdn_entry is the one rule for ui, dns and proxy.
# From: Issue #822 | PR #1912

# Format: "valid <domain>" or "invalid <domain>" per line.
# Length edge cases live in cdn_entry_matches_the_fixture.

valid example.com
valid cdn1.sub.example.com
valid steamcontent.com
valid .steamcontent.com
valid .download.nvidia.com

invalid localhost
invalid .
invalid ..example.com
invalid .bad..example.com
invalid example.com.
invalid bad..example.com
invalid -bad.example.com
invalid bad-.example.com
invalid bad_label.example.com
invalid example
